name: task-card
title: Task card
description: A compact card for a board or grid: title, label chips, due date, assignee stack and subtask progress, ready to be dragged.
docs: Put the cards in a ul. task is { id, title, href, cover, due, done, completedAt, assignees, subtasks }, labels are { id, label } chips above the title. The whole card is one link (task.href) or button (onOpen) with a ring around all of it on focus, and footer controls sit above it as their own tab stops. The card is a plain li that spreads every prop and the ref, so a drag library (dnd-kit, pragmatic-drag-and-drop) can wrap it; dragging gives it a firm border, a shadow and a small rise, selected a firm outline and aria-current. TaskCardSkeleton is the same card as a placeholder, with cover to reserve the image. The due date comes from DueDateLabel, so a date-only string is a calendar day; pass now for deterministic words in tests and previews.
